name: Click Assist
description: Early clicks are held for you and land on the first valid moment.

enabled.name: Enable click assist
enabled.description: Turn the assist on or off.

window.name: Assist window (ms)
window.description: How early before the perfect moment a click is still caught.

indicator.name: Show CLICK ASSIST indicator
indicator.description: Flash text on screen whenever the assist fires a click for you.
